scope: Source-backed integrity audit of CODOX-M/IVAC and actual synthetic engine exposure; no clinical record or treatment algorithm changes.

findings.observed: IVAC phase contains cytarabine, etoposide, rituximab and filgrastim but no ifosfamide or mesna. Missing drug survives actual engine materialization.
findings.evidence: eviQ 4490 v2 treatment schedule: ifosfamide days 1-5 with mesna; administration specifies hydration and uroprotection.
findings.required_change: Restore the block-specific ifosfamide and mesna reference context, then verify actual engine phases, legacy component view and all generated editions.

findings.observed: CODOX-M contains vincristine day 1 only and combines IV methotrexate with IT methotrexate days 1 and 3; omits IT cytarabine.
findings.evidence: eviQ 4489 v1 treatment schedule distinguishes vincristine days 1 and 8, IT cytarabine days 1 and 3, IV methotrexate day 10 and IT methotrexate day 15.
findings.required_change: Select and clearly identify one reference protocol variant for both blocks. Do not mix Magrath, modified CODOX-M, LMB, or proven-CNS schedules.

findings.observed: Both blocks use rituximab day 1 and filgrastim from day 13; HD-MTX preparation specifies leucovorin after 24 hours.
findings.evidence: eviQ 4489 and 4490 distinguish rituximab and filgrastim by block; 4489 starts IV folinate rescue 36 hours after IV methotrexate initiation, separately from oral folinate after IT methotrexate.
findings.required_change: Keep IV/IT folinate routes and clocks distinct; bind support to the selected block-specific protocol rather than copying one shared calendar.

findings.observed: CODOX-M/IVAC points to MON-R-CHOP-REGIMEN. CHOEP-alloSCT also inherits that schedule; their monitoring is not regimen-specific.
findings.evidence: Current YAML references; eviQ 4489 and 4490 contain methotrexate clearance, cytarabine and ifosfamide-specific assessment.
findings.required_change: Add regimen-specific CODOX/IVAC monitoring. Audit CHOEP induction/transplant monitoring separately; this audit does not verify the transplant choice.

findings.observed: Engine exposes the alternating four-block record in both low- and high-risk synthetic Burkitt tracks. Notes include CNS-positive disease while the encoded IT schedule is generic; age greater than 65 routes to another regimen automatically.
findings.evidence: eviQ 3727 distinguishes low-risk, high-risk and proven-CNS protocols; eviQ 4490 includes older-patient dose modifications.
findings.required_change: Audit actual track conditions, CNS involvement and age/fitness decisions against the selected source. Do not claim a schedule repair validates treatment selection.

release_requirements: Protocol-specific EN/UA rendered monitoring and route/timing assertions
All affected synthetic case and Wiki editions finalized with reader hashes
Canonical ZIP/TAR member scope and search row verification
Offline WASM loading and existing-case regressions
Explicit production authorization remains pending for draft PR 669
limits: No source guideline is treated as individualized prescribing authority.
No dose changes, clinical record changes, algorithm changes or production deployment were made by this audit.
Efficacy, Ukraine reimbursement, disease eligibility and other patient watchpoints remain unreviewed.
